description: Ministry of Finance - The Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the exercise of powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize purposes for specific societies and limit the application of the ordinance to them. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, specifically dealing with the legal framework governing societies. While it mentions Mahinda Rajapaksa as Prime Minister and Minister of Finance, this is only to establish the authority making the notification, not to announce personnel changes or describe portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about legal/regulatory matters rather than government structure or personnel.
